title: Volunteer register
summary: Saathi volunteer register: one row per volunteer with name, mobile, email, district, date joined, hours worked in September and stipend paid (rupees).

saathi_volunteers_register_2026_voluntee.meaning: volunteer's name (the sheet title is merged into this header)
saathi_volunteers_register_2026_voluntee.label: Volunteer

mobile.meaning: volunteer's 10-digit mobile number, may contain a space
mobile.label: Mobile

district.meaning: district the volunteer works in (no fixed list)
district.label: District

joined_on.meaning: date the volunteer joined, DD/MM/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD
joined_on.label: Joined on

stipend_paid.meaning: stipend paid to the volunteer so far, in rupees; blank means none paid yet
stipend_paid.label: Stipend paid (Rs)

validations.message: joining date is not a real date
joining date is in the future (typo?)
hours are not a number between 0 and 744

questions.ask: How many volunteers joined between two dates in each district, and how much stipend has been paid to them

start.description: first joining day to include, e.g. 2026-07-01

end.description: last joining day to include; defaults to today

questions.sql: SELECT COALESCE(district, 'All districts') AS district, count(*) AS volunteers_joined, sum(COALESCE(stipend_paid, 0)) AS stipend_paid_total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE stipend_paid IS NULL) AS no_stipend_recorded FROM {{table}} WHERE joined_on >= {{start}} AND joined_on <= COALESCE({{end}}, current_date) GROUP BY ROLLUP (district) ORDER BY GROUPING(district), district

history.taught: count volunteers joined since a date per district, with stipend paid
form fields: labels, measures, business rules (DGX migration to the form format)
